question: Does a Replay output of the UKF port contain XUKO records (vs XUKF)? (rung-1 pre-registration: UKF record = XUKO)
method: eval/diag/r1_scoring/rawscan.py (a strict dataflash walk: FMT table, records of undeclared types counted) and eval/df_reader.py on stored Replay outputs; one new light Replay by the INSTALLED binary (eval/diag/r1_scoring/xuko_replay.sh under heavy.py). Input logs only read.
verdict: XUKO is ABSENT (undecodable) in a Replay output of a log that does not already declare it, i.e. of every stock-flown rung-1 log: the fork's Replay writes XUKF/XUKO/XUKS (and XUKH) records WITHOUT their FMT records. The records are there under per-run dynamic type ids with no FMT. In a Replay of a FORK-flown log (whose input declares XUKO), the output carries the onboard XUKO copied through AND the replayed XUKO under one FMT, interleaved and indistinguishable (no instance field).
consequence_for_reading: pymavlink cannot read these outputs: its fast indexer stops the process ('Invalid length in FMT message'), its pure-Python reader returns about 15 XKF1 per core instead of thousands. eval/df_reader.py reads them in full (XKF1@100 TimeUS sequence = XKF1@0's).

logs.pymavlink: fast indexer exits at offset 252491; pure-Python reader: 15 XKF1 per core

logs.input: ukf_shadow_hdg_v2 (FORK-flown, UKF in shadow: 8 654 onboard XUKO)
logs.note: 17 283 = 8 654 copied onboard + 8 629 replayed, interleaved under one FMT

what_the_scorer_must_use: Until the port is fixed: the port's CURRENT-TIME output as a CSV with XUKO's exact columns (TimeUS,PN,PE,PD,VN,VE,VD,Roll,Pitch,Yaw,OV,EvO,EvMx,GpT,GpN), read with real_score.py --est-csv UKF=<ukf_output.csv>. The existing ukf_shadow.csv is NOT a substitute: it holds the HORIZON-time state (= XUKF). Preferred port fix: emit the FMT records of the UKF messages in Replay, so XUKO is read from the Replay output log itself. Port spec: docs/rung1_port_spec_capture_delay_xuko.md. Which source is used is a user ruling (the pre-registration names the record, not its file).
scope: Replay builds e8e9feac (2026-10-08) and earlier (stored outputs) and the installed be7c4d18 (new run). The rung1-geometry outputs of 2026-10-11 were not kept (run_one.sh deletes logs/).
